metadata.name: Incremind

paragraphs.text: 通过经历增量积累记忆、修正认识、逐渐形成理解的认知系统（Accumulate memory, revise knowledge and gradually form a cognitive syste
m of understanding through incremental experience.）
English · 简体中文
## Why I am building it
I want a second brain that can work alongside me over time.
The idea comes from everyday research. Whenever I ask AI a question or give it a task about the same
project, I have to explain the background, my existing judgments, and the material I have already f
ound all over again. Knowledge accumulates, but conversations often start from scratch.
Incremind is designed around two goals:
1. **Turn things I share into lasting knowledge.** Accept articles, personal judgments, recordings,
videos, and ideas captured on the go; organize them by project and scene; and turn them into knowled

ge I can revisit and insights I can confirm.
2. **Use that knowledge to understand questions and com
plete tasks.** Identify what I am asking, find the relevant projects and scenes, and give the model
their existing insights, sources, and context so it can answer everyday questions and handle routine
tasks with less repeated explanation.
Saving articles and videos does not automatically make their contents useful or memorable. Incremind
therefore focuses on **what each new source adds**:
- **Compare new material with existing insights.** Extract three kinds of changes: **additions** suc
h as new conditions, examples, or practices; **differences** from an existing claim; and **new metho
ds**. Material that repeats what you already know adds a supporting source to the existing insight r

ather than creating another entry.
- **Store methods with their conditions of use.** Each insight sa

ys when it applies, so relevant methods can be recalled when you ask a question or work on a task.
-
**Let you decide what becomes established knowledge.** Extracted insights start as pending confirma
tion. A single click on the receipt activates them. Confirmation, edits, and forgetting take effect

immediately; further inference runs in the background.
- **Remember and forget in a human-like way.*
* Frequently used knowledge becomes stronger, while unused knowledge gradually leaves automatic reca
ll. Originals remain in the Library and can be found and restored at any time.
[该节后续省略]
## Features
The workbench lets you capture material immediately and shows when the original is saved and when pr
ocessing finishes. The homepage shows pending insights and recent activity for the current project,
with `#`, `/`, and `@` input shortcuts. Settings organize models by purpose and offer templates when
creating a project. Supported quick commands show a preview before applying changes. The shared UI
conventions are maintained in DESIGN.md.
| Status | Feature | What it does |
| ✅ | **One input box** | Automatically handles remembering, asking, and doing tasks. Mixed requests
are split and handled separately. Personal receipts support changing actions, merging adjacent part
s, and removing parts, with source and state checks before execution. Original results are retained.

|
| ✅ | **Automatic organization** | Builds memory in layers: original → organized note + summary →

insight. Supports text, links, PDFs, and DOCX files. |
| ✅ | **Automatic project assignment** | Wit
hout an explicit `#Project`, assigns material to the most relevant existing project or creates one f
or a new topic. Everyday items stay in the Everyday space. Assignment can be undone with one click.

|
| ✅ | **Incremental insights** | Compares material with existing insights and proposes additions,

differences, and new methods for confirmation on the receipt. |
| ✅ | **Answers with citations** | U
ses eligible insights, summaries, organized notes, and originals as evidence; citations open the ori

ginal source. Questions in Everyday can be routed to the relevant project. |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and data
- **Local first.** Sources, organized notes, insights, and conversations are stored in the data dire
ctory on the computer or server hosting the application. SQLite stores structured records; uploaded
originals such as PDFs, images, audio, and video are stored as separate files. Back up the entire da

ta directory.
- **Server permissions.** Ordinary users have separate spaces. Administrators can ente
r user spaces according to their permissions, and access logs are visible to the affected user. Disa
bling an account preserves its content and access history; permanent deletion requires confirmation
and removes the account, its space, and associated records. Private material is not hidden from admi

nistrators.
- **Encrypted credentials.** Model keys and website cookies use the existing encrypted s
ecret store: DPAPI on Windows and the existing server store on servers. Saved values are not returne

d or logged. Website cookies are excluded from model inputs.
- **Controlled external transmission.**
External models are called only for purposes whose transmission switches you enable in **Settings →
Models**. Private projects and sources are excluded. Every external request leaves a receipt record

ing what was sent and which model received it. See the model guide (Chinese).
- **Originals are reta
ined.** Forgetting affects automatic recall. Originals, organized notes, insight text, and revision
history remain available for restoration.
## Known limitations
- **Speed:** latency varies with material length, model, selection, and cache state. Individual runs
are recorded in the evaluation overview. Startup maintenance, backups, and indexing also affect res

ponse times.
- **Platform:** basic complete flows have been checked on Windows. Application deployme
nt, CPU embeddings, and real DeepSeek Harness execution in isolation have been checked separately on

Ubuntu 22.04. The application interface is currently Chinese only.
- **Mobile sharing and website l
ogin:** OS sharing and iPhone Shortcuts await device validation; real-account QR confirmation has no

t been verified. Xiaohongshu sessions currently use cookie import.
- **In progress:** validation of
the mobile shell, shared projects, production public-network task submission, and real-account execu
tion and reconnection for Claude Code and Codex.
